name: Saved Search
description: Saved searches: notes that keep a query of the search language and its results

settings.title: Refresh delay
settings.description: Minutes between runs of a saved search after the index changes
settings.details: Minutes a saved search whose tab is closed waits after its last run before an index change runs it again; 0 runs it at once. A saved search whose tab is open, and a change of its query, run at once.

settings.title: Folder of new saved searches
settings.description: Folder an agent creates a saved search in when it names none
settings.details: Folder of the vault, relative to the vault folder, that saved_search_create puts a note in when the agent names no folder; empty is the vault folder.
